claim_scope: PromptToTask contract-only training pair and checkpoint state shape

rows.literal_requirement: A trainable PromptToTask pair/DTO shape exists for prompt-to-task DPO/training without raw private prompt text.
rows.actual_value: ref/hash based pair; no RawPrompt/PromptText property

rows.literal_requirement: Required source/provenance refs exist: source_row_id or equivalent, chosen_ref/approved_pair_ref, rejected_ref, error_code/taxonomy, source hash/ref, split/heldout support.
rows.actual_value: SourceRowId, ApprovedPairRef, ChosenRef, RejectedRef, ErrorCode, ErrorTaxonomyRef, SourcePromptSha256, SourceManifestRef, SplitId, SplitRole, HeldOutSetId

rows.literal_requirement: Checkpoint state fields exist: checkpoint id/hash or learned-state id, schema version, row count/pair count, source manifest ref, model/training-state refs needed by future export/import/fresh-load/continue.
rows.actual_value: LearnedStateId, CheckpointId, CheckpointSha256, SchemaVersion, SourceRowCount, DpoPairCount, SourceManifestRef, ModelStateRef, TrainingStateRef, ExportManifestRef, FreshLoadProbeRef, ContinueTrainingStateRef

rows.literal_requirement: Public surfaces follow OperationResult discipline where applicable; no null/bool-only contract surface newly added.
rows.actual_value: DTO records only added; no public method added; existing OperationResult builder preserved

rows.literal_requirement: No deterministic classifier/inference implementation is added in PTT-01. Skeleton may remain honest not-ready.
rows.actual_artifact: rg deterministic shortcut sweep and PromptToTaskContracts tests
rows.actual_value: No classifier/trainer/lookup/BM25/regex added; machine remains not-ready/no-inference

rows.literal_requirement: Raw prompt text/private source text is not persisted in committed contract artifacts.
rows.actual_value: Training pair uses refs and hashes; artifacts contain no private corpus rows

rows.literal_requirement: Positive/negative DPO shape is plausible near-miss capable and compatible with strategy docs.
